title: Salary Components of Prime Minister and Ministers
what_it_is: Salary Components of Prime Minister and Ministers

sections.label: 2012 Committee salary norm
sections.summary: In 2012 the Committee recommended a $1.1 million annual salary norm for an entry level MR4 Minister, a 40% discount to the market reference.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: In 2012, the Committee recommended a norm level of $1.1 million as the total annual salary for an entry level MR4 Minister, based on a 40% discount to the market reference, to reflect the ethos of public service.

sections.label: Bonus components within salary norm
sections.summary: All fixed and variable pay, including bonuses, form part of the $1.1 million norm for an entry level MR4 Minister, not additions to it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: All the components added up – fixed pay plus variable pay, including any and all bonuses – make up the norm level of $1.1 million for an entry level MR4 Minister.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: I underline this point, Mr Speaker, all the bonus components form part of, and are not in addition to, the $1.1 million salary norm.

sections.label: Prime Minister salary norm
sections.summary: The independent Committee recommended the Prime Minister's total norm annual salary be two times an entry level MR4 Minister's, that is $2.2 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The independent Committee recommended that the Prime Minister’s total norm annual salary should be two times that of an entry level MR4 Minister, that is, $2.2 million.

sections.label: Bonus ranges 2013 to 2017
sections.summary: From 2013 to 2017, National Bonus averaged 4.1 months, Performance Bonus 4.3 months, and Annual Variable Component 1.3 months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Between 2013 and 2017, for the National Bonus, the range was between 3.4 and 4.9 months, with the average over the five years being 4.1 months; for Performance Bonus the range was from three to six months each year, with the average across all the Political Office Holders over five years at 4.3 months; for the Annual Variable Component, the range was 0.95 to 1.5 months over the period and the average over the five years was 1.3 months.

sections.label: Workers' Party 2012 formula
sections.summary: The WP's 2012 formula gave a similar total salary but 81% fixed pay, about $800,800, and 19% variable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: If Members could refer to Handout 3 (Annex 3), the formula put forward by the Workers' Party (WP) in 2012 would have resulted in essentially the same total annual salary level for the MR 4 entry level Minister as that recommended by the independent Committee.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: But the WP formula would have had a higher level of fixed component of 81%, amounting to roughly $800,800, compared to the White Paper's proposal and a smaller variable component of 19%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: And this means that the WP would have paid out a higher portion of the salary – about $880,000 out of $1.1 million – regardless of individual performance or national outcomes, and even if the outcomes were not achieved.

sections.label: Salary kept at 2012 level
sections.summary: Although the MR4 benchmark rose 9% since 2011, the Government kept the salary structure and salary at the 2012 level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Though the MR4 benchmark had increased by 9% since 2011, the Government decided to maintain the current salary structure and keep salary at the 2012 level.

sections.label: Ministerial pensions and MediSave benefits
sections.summary: Ministerial pensions were discontinued in 2012 and Ministers receive the same MediSave contributions as Civil Servants under the MSO Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: And that is, essentially, part of the structure of the framework that was put in place in 2012.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: And I can confirm to Mr Alex Yam that Ministerial pensions were discontinued in 2012, as part of the revision of the framework, and that Ministers receive the same MediSave contributions, percentages and numbers, as Civil Servants do, under the MediSave-cum-Subsidised Outpatient (MSO) Scheme for medical benefits.

sections.label: Reply timing and $1.1 million framework
sections.summary: The question asks whether a fuller September reply to Mr Leon Perera could have pre-empted online misinformation, with all components within the $1.1 million framework since 2012.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The second question I have is with regard to whether the Deputy Prime Minister agrees that in response to Mr Leon Perera's PQ filed on 10 September, whether the Government could have pre-empted some of the misinformation that occurred online had a fuller and more expansive reply been given to Mr Leon Perera in September.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: And the most important aspect of that answer is that all the components are within the framework of $1.1 million that was put in place since 2012.

sections.label: National Bonus and Annual Variable Component
sections.summary: The National Bonus and Annual Variable Component are the same for all Ministers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: For the National Bonus and the Annual Variable Component, it is the same for all Ministers.

sections.label: Releasing average Performance Bonus figure
sections.summary: The question asks whether the figure could have been released in September with the average Performance Bonus figure, and notes the National Bonus calculation method is well-known.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: If not, then would that not have been an opportunity to also release that figure in September together with the average Performance Bonus figure?

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: And in fact, the method of calculating the National Bonus is well-known.

sections.label: Ministerial salaries White Paper accuracy
sections.summary: The Ministerial salaries 2012 White Paper and the Workers' Party's formula table shared with the House are accurate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: The Ministerial salaries 2012 White Paper versus the Workers' Party's formula table that the Deputy Prime Minister had shared with the House is accurate.

sections.label: Select Committee recommendation on online falsehoods
sections.summary: Recommendation 9 states public institutions should provide information in response to online falsehoods in a timely manner and pre-empt vulnerabilities in advance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Recommendation 9 of the Select Committee's Report states that "Public institutions should wherever possible provide information to the public in response to online falsehoods in a timely manner.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: They should also seek to pre-empt vulnerabilities and put out information in advance where appropriate to inoculate the public.

sections.label: Factually and salary dollar value
sections.summary: A speaker notes that on 16 September Factually presents the components as the Deputy Prime Minister did, and suggests putting out the dollar value to reduce misinformation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: And on 16 September "Factually" presents the components as the Deputy Prime Minister did.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: But I would suggest to the Deputy Prime Minister that if we put out the dollar value, the prospect of more misinformation can be reduced.

sections.label: Minister salary structure and benchmark
sections.summary: The speaker clarifies that all salary components including Variable Pay are part of the 2012 benchmarked structure of $1.1 million for an entry level Minister at MR4, unchanged since 2012 despite a 9% rise in the MR4 benchmark.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: So, perhaps, Mr Speaker, Sir, allow me to clarify the position and I hope that the Workers' Party will help us to clarify the position by putting it on your website also, especially as Mr Pritam Singh has agreed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: So, the key facts are these: first, all salary components, including the Variable Pay, are part of the salary structure benchmarked in 2012 at $1.1 million for an entry level Minister at MR4.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Second, the salary structure and benchmark have not changed since 2012.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: I reported to Parliament earlier this year that the Government had decided not to adjust salaries even though the MR4 benchmark had increased by 9%.
